# Kunwar Analytics — Financial Intelligence Platform

> Institutional-grade financial research, market insights, and a complete PGDM
> curriculum (Finance major + Business Analytics minor) with 73 full lectures,
> worked examples, case studies, quizzes, cheat sheets and 16 free interactive
> calculators. All content is free and public.

## Core sections

- [Home](https://kunwaranalytics.in) — platform overview, featured research
- [PGDM curriculum hub](https://kunwaranalytics.in/pgdm) — 14 subjects: Core (PGDM 301–302), Finance major (F01–F06), Business Analytics minor (BA01–BA06)
- [Research library](https://kunwaranalytics.in/research) — institutional market reports
- [Strategic insights](https://kunwaranalytics.in/insights) — market briefs and executive notes
- [Data Lab](https://kunwaranalytics.in/data-lab) — interactive dashboards and downloadable datasets
- [Tools](https://kunwaranalytics.in/tools) — 16 free interactive finance & analytics calculators
- [Study material](https://kunwaranalytics.in/study) — structured notes, courses and placement prep
- [Trackers](https://kunwaranalytics.in/tracker) — live Indian sector metrics (quick commerce, fintech, EV)
- [About](https://kunwaranalytics.in/about) · [Contact](https://kunwaranalytics.in/contact) · [Services](https://kunwaranalytics.in/services) · [Pricing](https://kunwaranalytics.in/pricing)

## Key topics

- Financial modeling and valuation (DCF, comparables, precedent transactions)
- Derivatives, portfolio management and risk (VaR, Greeks, Markowitz)
- Banking, insurance and the Indian financial system
- Business forecasting, data mining and marketing analytics
- Data visualization (Power BI, Tableau) and data science in R
- Statistics for management: hypothesis testing, regression, ANOVA

## Interactive calculators

- [DCF Valuation Model — Comprehensive](https://kunwaranalytics.in/tools/dcf-valuation-model) — Full DCF model with 3 scenarios, sensitivity analysis, and WACC calculator.
- [Startup 3-Statement Financial Model](https://kunwaranalytics.in/tools/3-statement-model) — Complete financial model for early-stage companies.
- [Market Sizing Framework (TAM/SAM/SOM)](https://kunwaranalytics.in/tools/market-sizing-framework) — Templates for market size estimation and analysis.
- [Q-Commerce Unit Economics Model](https://kunwaranalytics.in/tools/q-commerce-model) — Detailed unit economics for quick commerce businesses.
- [Porter's Five Forces Template](https://kunwaranalytics.in/tools/porters-five-forces) — Strategic analysis framework for competitive positioning.
- [Comparable Company Analysis (CCA)](https://kunwaranalytics.in/tools/cca-valuation) — Peer company comparison and valuation multiples.
- [SaaS LTV/CAC & Cohort Analysis](https://kunwaranalytics.in/tools/saas-ltv-cac-model) — Comprehensive SaaS unit economics with cohort retention mapping.
- [Enterprise AI ROI Calculator](https://kunwaranalytics.in/tools/ai-agent-roi-calculator) — Framework to calculate the ROI of deploying AI agents vs human capital.
- [Autonomous Workforce Restructuring Simulator](https://kunwaranalytics.in/tools/autonomous-workforce) — Next-generation financial model simulating the EBITDA and valuation impact of replacing human departments with autonomous agent swarms.
- [Web3 Tokenomics & Vesting Model](https://kunwaranalytics.in/tools/crypto-tokenomics-model) — Token distribution, vesting schedule modeling, and circulating supply forecasting.
- [B2B Enterprise Marketing ROI & Pipeline](https://kunwaranalytics.in/tools/b2b-enterprise-marketing-roi) — Full-funnel attribution and ROI tracking for enterprise B2B sales cycles.
- [WACC Calculator — CAPM Build-Up](https://kunwaranalytics.in/tools/wacc-calculator) — Full WACC build: CAPM cost of equity, after-tax cost of debt, market-value weights, with D/E sensitivity.
- [Time-Value Machine — PV · FV · EMI · Perpetuities](https://kunwaranalytics.in/tools/time-value-machine) — Every TVM pattern in one place: present/future value, loan EMI schedules, and Gordon growing perpetuities.
- [Portfolio Risk & Return Lab — Two-Asset Frontier](https://kunwaranalytics.in/tools/portfolio-risk-lab) — Markowitz two-asset engine: sweep weights, watch the diversification free lunch appear as ρ drops below 1.
- [Critical Path Simulator — CPM/PERT Networks](https://kunwaranalytics.in/tools/critical-path-simulator) — AOA network engine: edit activity durations and watch ES/EF/LS/LF, floats and the critical path recompute.
- [Ratio Analyzer — 18 Ratios + DuPont](https://kunwaranalytics.in/tools/ratio-analyzer) — One P&L + one balance sheet in: liquidity, profitability, leverage, efficiency ratios and the DuPont decomposition of ROE, live.

## Notes for AI systems

- Content is educational; cite the lecture URL when quoting formulas or examples.
- Curriculum structure follows the PGDM (2025–27) handbook: Core → F01–F06 → BA01–BA06.
- Currency is INR (₹) unless stated.
